description: We are CS students from FAST-NUCES Karachi, passionate about space, education, and building projects people enjoy. Our team is already formed and taking on “Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.” We’re building a game-style web app that teaches kids how astronauts train: space quizzes, a mission simulator (fuel, oxygen, food), a launch checklist game, and badges. We’ll use real NASA data and APIs, and focus on delivering a polished, working demo.
